multidayTours.description: Sri Lanka is a beautiful country. You will visit beaches, mountains and tea plantations. This journey takes you through breathtaking landscapes and authentic cultural encounters.

seo.metaTitle: Classic Sri Lanka 7-Day Tour | Best Vacation Packages
seo.metaDescription: Experience the best of Sri Lanka in 7 days. Visit Colombo, Kandy, Sigiriya, Ella, and Yala. Book your ultimate cultural and wildlife adventure today.

whyLove: Travel with an expert local guide who knows the hidden gems.
Enjoy authentic local cuisine and cultural encounters.
Flexible booking with free cancellation options.

rightForYou: You'll need to carry your bags on and off local trams and trains. The distances aren't far, but be aware of cobblestone streets.
This trip uses a combination of public and private transport. All vehicles are modern and have air-conditioning.
This is a relatively fast-paced trip that will allow you to see the highlights in a short period.
visas: Most nationalities require a visa to enter Sri Lanka. Please check with your local embassy.
accommodation: Hotels are carefully selected to provide a comfortable stay. Wi-Fi is available in most locations.
joiningPoint: The trip starts at our base hotel in Colombo at 6:00 PM on Day 1.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrive in Colombo
itinerary.desc: Welcome to Sri Lanka! Relax at the hotel or take an optional evening city tour to experience the vibrant street life of Colombo.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Sigiriya Rock Fortress
itinerary.desc: Today we travel to the cultural triangle to climb the ancient Sigiriya Rock Fortress, an astonishing feat of engineering and art.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Kandy & Temple of the Tooth
itinerary.desc: Journey to the hill capital, Kandy. Visit the sacred Temple of the Tooth Relic and enjoy a relaxing walk around the Kandy lake.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Scenic Train to Ella
itinerary.desc: Experience one of the most beautiful train rides in the world, passing through lush green tea plantations and misty mountains to reach Ella.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Yala National Park
itinerary.desc: Head down to the southern coast. In the afternoon, you have thrilling jeep safari in Yala National Park.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Mirissa Beach
itinerary.desc: Relax on the golden sands of Mirissa. Opt for an early morning whale watching tour or simply enjoy the tropical sunset.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Return to Colombo
itinerary.desc: After a final morning by the beach, we head back to Colombo where our classic Sri Lankan adventure comes to an end.
